help/traumamember.json.title: TraumaTeam Membership
section:
Main functions:
 Open your phone contact list, select TraumaTeam Membership Offers to subscribe to an plan.

Plan 01 (25000$) :
 Trauma Team comes help to you when your health is under 120. If you are outside, our team comes to take you to med center in 20 second. 
  If you are inside, our team (1 soldier) comes to help you to in 20 second.

Plan 02 (50000$) :
 Trauma Team comes help to you when your health is under 120. If you are outside, our team comes to take you to med center in 7 second. 
  If you are inside, our team (2 soldier) comes to help you to in 7 second.

Plan 03 (100000$) :
 Trauma Team comes help to you when your health is under 120. If you are outside, our team comes to take you to med center in 3 second. 
  If you are inside, our team (4 soldier) comes to help you to in 3 second.

mission/trauma_mission.json.content:
Join the TraumaTeam and help us to save life ! 
Our Trauma Team subexternal partnership Program let mercs like you help us during intervention, it's a mutual win-win situation : 
- You get the danger that you need ! 
- We reduce our cost by using unexperim...skilled externals for save our clients' life ! 
Go to the med center and talk to our TraumaTeam officer for be a part of this amazing program !

sound/Jobs Of Night City Trauma Team.jso.subtitle: Ok, we got a 3-5-5. We got a merc, V, who will team up with us as external subcontractor, part of the Trauma Team subexternal partnership. You know, reduce cost and all that shit.
Trauma module report that the victim have seveal injuries
OK, we are almost good !
All right, area is safe. Go !
Keep the area safe, the client is the priority ! V, move your ass !
All right, we will arrive soon. Stay calm during the landing.
Don't mess with us, we got our ass covered !
Fuck, it's a carnage.. Sergent... Fuck
placeholder
Ok, victim is stable, we move to the AV ! V, cover us !
I do what I can !

T1, the medical assitance that you provide is good. Don't forget to flash the firmware on the secure boot if needed. T2,T3, and you, V, you were efficent to protect the area and the client. T2, I suggest next time that you need to be closer to the victim and the landing area.

V, the medical assitance that you provide is very good for a newcomer. Well done. T1,T2 and you,T3, you were efficent to protect the area and the client. T2, I suggest next time that you need to be closer to the victim and the landing area.
All right, heart rate is more than 50. We can evacuate the client.
All right, heart rate is more than 50. We can evacuate the client.
Focus, you are near from saving a life !
Fortunately, there were no hostiles around. The mission could turn in another color if there was
Ok, V, you can go back to the AV !
Go ! Go ! Go !
T1,T2 and T3, move the victim at the block. V, you was a good hand. Wait me 5 seconds
Remember. Quick and safe. Be efficient and we must save the client. Good luck everyone.
Heart rate continues to grow, I'm on it !
Heart rate is low, I'm on it !
Heart rate is low, I'm on it !
Heart rate is low, I'm on it !
Heart rate continues to grow, I'm on it !
Hey hey hey !!! It's Trauma Team!
NCPD systems report that there is hostile presence around.
I will say the briefing in the AV. Go inside ! Hurry !
It was short. 10 second later, neural circuits would be fried. That person is lucky.
We are aware about loss in squad. The client is still alive. At least, the mission is still a success.
I connect you to the medical HUD.
Fuck them off ! I lost my guys and they look at us like throwable meat.. Anyway, I will take a glass tonight. In memory, you see ?
Shit ! C'mon, stay alive !
Shit ! C'mon, stay alive !
Ok, vitals are stabilized. Move out !
NCPD systems report that there is no hostile presence around.
The victim's health is low. Protect the area until we finish the first aid.
Shit ! Be careful there is some gangs around ! Protect the client !
Recovery OK ! Reboot in progress...
Extraction is not possible at your position.
We send a squad to your position but stay hidden until they are here
You're safe. Squad is leaving.
They will protect you until you're out of danger.
Vitals are low, secure the area. I will apply first aid to the victim.
Sending Short-Circuit broadcast to the area !
Stay calm, V ! Stay focused, we got you covered !
Ok, vitals function are still stable, we can move in the surgery block.
T1, your role is apply first aid and stabilize the health of the victim. T2,T3, me and you, V, we will secure the area and protect T1 during the intervention
Take that, fucker ! Stay down the line !
V, thanks for your help. It was efficient and clear. We like this kind of help any time so don't hesitate to take a new contract with us. Now, Dismiss !
Thanks for joining the Trauma Team Subexternal Partnership Program. Get ready for the mission.
Damn, theses gangs are more aggressive every days. Fortunately, no loss.. But I will have a tons of papers for that..
The vitals are ok now. Up to the doc to save the day.
V, your role is apply first aid and stabilize the health rate to 50. T1,T2,T3 and me, we will secure the area and protect V during the intervention.
We send a team for move the victim at the block. V, thanks for your help. Wait my instructions.
V, Trauma Team thanks you for your help, whatever happens to the squad. They know the risk. Anyway, You can subscribe to our program when you need. Now, Dismiss !
The client is awake.
Soldier ! Don't talk about that ! It's a confidential case.
A merc.. Theses guys got hard life...
Remember that guy ? Martinez ? The corpse was completely destroyed after Smasher hit it.
Did you see the new sergeant's joy ?
The more it shines, the more it slips as he said...
We will arrive. Shut up your mouth if you don't want any troubles !
Yeah she got some chrome at right place !
That's was short...
Man, I'm sure it's all about his Wizzy's obsession..
Yes sir ! Sorry sir !
